conflicts.description: These two records establish mutually exclusive rules for when a termination 'clock' starts. Record ...dccdb230__2.1 states the clock is considered to be running even *before* written notice is received. Record ...dccdb230__3.1 states the clock *only* starts upon receipt of written notice. Both attach severe, non-waivable penalties to this distinction, creating a critical and irreconcilable legal ambiguity.
